verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents NerdGraph, a GraphQL-format API, and an interactive API explorer. Neither describes a downloadable, machine-readable spec or schema file. The probe found 404s at every common OpenAPI/Swagger path, and llms.txt is documentation markdown rather than an API specification, so the API and explorer are only adjacent to this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
